_comment: DEMO BOOKING AVAILABILITY. This is demo data for the demo booking system - it is NOT the real opening hours. Tune the values below to change what the calendar and time slots offer.

_notes.closedWeekdays: JavaScript Date.getDay() numbering: 0=Sunday ... 6=Saturday. [0] = closed on Sunday, matching the Sunday row in hours.json.
_notes.busyRatio: Fraction of otherwise-free slots hidden to demonstrate unavailable slots (0 = everything free).
_notes.seed: Seeded pseudo-random generator - the same date always produces the same pattern, so availability is stable across reloads.
_notes.blackoutDates: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) shown as fully booked.
_notes.leadTimeMinutes: Slots sooner than this from 'now' are hidden for today.
